candidates.change_summary: Change the return statement from `return true;` to `return false;` so successful calls return false instead of true.
Change the msg.sender authorization check to a different address so the original owner now reverts.
Delete the msg.sender authorization check so any address can call transfer.
Invert the length check to require _tos.length == 0, so non-empty calls revert.
Remove the 1e18 scaling so transferred amounts are v[i] instead of v[i]*10^18.
Use msg.sender as the token source instead of the fixed `from` address.
Delete the revert on failed external call so transfer returns true even when a transferFrom fails.
Return false instead of true on the success path.
